Do not use the app or website for unlawful activity, to infringe another person’s rights, or to interfere with the website’s operation. Keep access to your device secure and use your device’s settings to control camera and file permissions.

Your documents and content

You retain your rights in your documents, photos and recognized text. Processing them on your phone does not transfer their ownership to the publisher. The offline edition does not upload them to an OCR server.

You choose where to share and export content. Copies sent to other applications or saved outside this app are governed by those destinations and remain your responsibility. Keep your own copies of important documents.

Recognition and feature limits

OCR can make mistakes, including omitted words, characters, numbers and formatting. Review and correct recognized text before relying on it, especially for important records or decisions. Results vary with language, image quality, handwriting and layout.

This edition recognizes English, French and Arabic and offers simple formatted, text and Markdown views. It does not reconstruct complex tables or embedded images. It exports TXT, Markdown and HTML; it does not export PDF or searchable PDF. Cropping is manual, and the app does not promise automatic document edge detection.

Free and optional Pro

From version 1.1.0, Free supports up to 3 pages per document, all OCR languages and editing tools, TXT export, copy, share, history and favorites. Optional Pro unlocks up to 25 pages per document and Markdown/HTML file exports. From version 1.2.0, confirmed Pro also suppresses ads. Version 1.2.1 can select test or commercial advertising through app configuration. The current mode is OFF: test and commercial advertising are disabled through app configuration. Required privacy choices and Pro ad suppression apply in either mode. Earlier 1.0.1 documents stay readable; they are not deleted when upgrading.

Pro is a one-time purchase for this app edition, not a recurring subscription. The proposed base price is USD 4.99; Galaxy Store displays the applicable local price and any taxes before you confirm payment. The purchase must be available in your region and is subject to Samsung’s payment and refund rules and any mandatory consumer rights. Future separate products are not promised as part of Pro.

Buy or restore using the same Samsung account through Galaxy Store. Confirmed access is cached for offline use and updated when ownership is checked. A refunded or unavailable entitlement may be removed. Clearing app data removes the local cache; restore purchases to recover eligible ownership. If confirmation is interrupted, restore before trying another purchase.

We do not guarantee uninterrupted website access, compatibility with every device or recovery of deleted app data. The app disables Android backup of its private data, so retain any files you need separately.
